response.overview: A couple takes a short walk after she returns home from work, while he remains unemployed, struggling to finish his Fine Arts degree and pursue his passion for painting. As they walk, long-suppressed frustrations and unspoken resentments slowly surface. What begins as an ordinary evening turns into their final argument—a confrontation over the choices they have made, the expectations they carry, and the growing distance between them.
response.tagline: Sometimes love ends long before people leave
response.title: Missing Steps
